agenda_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  June 29, 2020

11:30 a.m. – Finance Executive Conference, 1th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the June 08, 2020, meeting.

  2. ALTA Environmental – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for testing for
  mold at the Veterans Memorial facility and the 8th floor.

  3. The Guy Black Show Live – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the
  planning and management of the Divine Nine event Rally at the Forum on June 6, 2020.

  4. L.A. Business Printing – Executive session to discuss to recommend payment for printing
  costs associated to COVID-19.

Closed Session - Confidential
  1. Closed session-Confidential-Attorney/Client Privileged; Executive closed session Claims
  Review Committee with Legal Counsel regarding pending litigation pursuant to California
  Government Code §54956.9(d)(2)); Richard Hicks Claim for damages.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.
